scope: Targeted nonexhaustive map:44 nodes, formal proof premises separated from framework choices, measured inputs, numerical evidence and open bridges.
dependency_semantics: Node dependencies name prerequisites or context for planning. Only a proved_hyperedge explicitly asserts a validated implication of its entire from-set under the target assumptions. No edge may be reversed as implication.

edge_types.assumption: Target adopts the premise or framework; no derivation of physical truth.
edge_types.proved_hyperedge: The conjunction of every source node and the listed target assumptions supports the conclusion.
edge_types.restricted_analogue: Shared mechanism in a different scope; transfer not licensed.
edge_types.unresolved_bridge: A required proof, estimate, observable or closure is missing.

nodes.title: Classical implication and proof search
nodes.statement: Backward theorem application opens all missing premises; it never reverses an implication.
assumptions: Frozen finite rule library for executable search
nodes.scope: The search planner proposes dependency paths; proof checking decides validity.
nodes.next_obligation: Formalize selected statements and audit every rule application.

nodes.title: Real calculus and inner-product identities
nodes.statement: Chain rules, Cauchy–Schwarz and antisymmetry of the cross product support the finite energy argument.
nodes.scope: These mathematical facts do not choose a physical closure.
nodes.next_obligation: Check every differentiation against the definitions.

nodes.title: Local ODE theory and continuation
nodes.statement: A locally Lipschitz finite ODE has a unique local solution; compact confinement permits continuation.
assumptions: Open state domain and local Lipschitz regularity
nodes.scope: Teschl sections2.2,2.4,2.6; additional estimates are required for global existence.
nodes.next_obligation: Prove confinement and exclude denominator degeneracy.

nodes.title: Quantum state and unitary-evolution postulates
nodes.statement: Positive density operators and unitary dynamics specify the quantum blocks used in the model.
nodes.scope: A physical framework, not a theorem derived from an ODE computation.
nodes.next_obligation: Specify admissible state families before response calculations.

nodes.title: Maxwell–Dirac gauge framework
nodes.statement: An abelian gauge connection coupled to a Dirac field supplies the electromagnetic matter framework.
assumptions: Chosen action, quantum state and approximation
nodes.scope: The finite matched model is a selected approximation within this framework.
nodes.next_obligation: Derive and renormalize its continuum causal observables consistently.

nodes.title: Einstein gravitational framework
nodes.statement: The metric obeys Einstein equations with a declared total stress tensor and any specified higher-curvature terms.
nodes.scope: A physical field equation; flat-space mode dynamics alone does not establish it.
nodes.next_obligation: Fix the approximation order and gravitational initial constraints.

nodes.title: Measured constants and frozen parameter choice
nodes.statement: The solver freezes alpha=1/137.035999084; the proof needs only alpha<1/137.
assumptions: No silent update of historical parameters
nodes.scope: A measured constant is not a mathematical axiom; the inequality is a model premise.
nodes.next_obligation: Keep parameter provenance separate from exact arithmetic.

nodes.title: Bloch-ball positivity
nodes.statement: The matrix (I+r·sigma)/2 is positive exactly when |r|<=1.
nodes.scope: Pure blocks lie on the sphere; mixed blocks lie inside.
nodes.next_obligation: Distinguish fixed-norm tangents from variations of purity.

nodes.title: Positive Gauss–Legendre quadrature
nodes.statement: Exact Gauss weights are positive and integrate constants exactly.
nodes.scope: Rounded coefficient lists require their own exact or interval check.
nodes.next_obligation: Audit the generated weights rather than assuming exact identities.

nodes.title: Digamma recurrence and Binet positivity
nodes.statement: For b>0 the matched susceptibility bracket has a positive Binet-integral representation.
nodes.scope: Proves the sign of the chosen coefficient, not the matching prescription.
nodes.next_obligation: Use positivity to obtain a global denominator certificate.

nodes.title: Newtonian gravitational limit
nodes.statement: Newtonian gravitational interactions form a separate weak-field context, including current entanglement arguments.
assumptions: Slow sources and specified boundary conditions
nodes.scope: The cited paper concerns the Newtonian regime; it is not used as a proof of the full relativistic limit or any strong-curvature claim.
nodes.next_obligation: Verify the small parameters before invoking the limit.

nodes.title: Finite homogeneous regulator and state
nodes.statement: Use fixed finite positive weights, positive masses and canonical momenta; production has b=10,K=20,n=0..4.
assumptions: Initial Bloch vectors inside unit balls
nodes.scope: The regulator and externally supported magnetic background are part of the contract.
nodes.next_obligation: Control independent momentum-window and Landau limits.

nodes.title: Matched finite Maxwell–Dirac closure
nodes.statement: The mode equations and shared S,C,D,Z and energy definitions are fixed by T1–T5.
nodes.scope: Algebraic consistency does not independently prove continuum renormalization.
nodes.next_obligation: Derive common covariant current and stress observables.

nodes.title: Admissible drive and parameter families
nodes.statement: Use continuous drives; smooth compact pumps and differentiable source families support the production response.
assumptions: L1 drive for uniform field envelope
nodes.scope: No spatial horizon or radial boundary is introduced in this temporal IVP.
nodes.next_obligation: Retain preparation and delayed-probe support exactly.

nodes.title: All-potential coefficient margin
nodes.statement: For the selected regulator, Z(a)>3/4 for every real a.
assumptions: Exact positive quadrature or separately certified rounded coefficients
nodes.scope: The certificate does not depend on sampled trajectory minima.
nodes.next_obligation: For a changed regulator, prove a new sufficient margin or sharper bound.

nodes.title: Invariant Bloch norms
nodes.statement: Precession preserves each |r_i|, hence the initial Bloch balls.
nodes.scope: Floating trajectories have measurable norm errors; they are not exact theorem objects.
nodes.next_obligation: Check numerical norm defects without clipping.

nodes.title: Positive finite excitation energy
nodes.statement: Positive weights and |r_i|<=1 imply U=sum w_i(h_i·r_i+omega_i)>=0.
nodes.scope: This finite positivity does not assert positivity of renormalized continuum stress.
nodes.next_obligation: Establish any proposed continuum energy control independently.

nodes.title: Exact shared work balance
nodes.statement: With W=Zx²/2+e²U, the frozen equations give Wdot=xF.
nodes.scope: The identity can hold for an inaccurate finite regulator.
nodes.next_obligation: Check observables and independent refinements as well as work.

nodes.title: Electric-field envelope
nodes.statement: |x(t)|<=sqrt(2W0/z*)+||F||L1(0,t)/z*; vacuum unit impulse gives |x|<=4/3.
nodes.scope: Zero initial energy is handled using sqrt(W+epsilon); this is not a derivative bound.
nodes.next_obligation: Seek a separate norm if claiming response stability.

nodes.title: Selected global-forward theorem
nodes.statement: The selected finite system has a unique classical solution on every finite future interval.
assumptions: Frozen finite model and admissible data
nodes.scope: Global existence is not continuum correctness or asymptotic stability.
nodes.next_obligation: Investigate regulator-uniform estimates and admissible limits.

nodes.title: Finite-time tangent and retarded support
nodes.statement: Differentiable source/state families satisfy the tangent system; unchanged preparation gives zero response before a delayed probe.
nodes.scope: No uniform-in-time tangent norm or quantum noise kernel follows.
nodes.next_obligation: Construct stronger response estimates or a discriminating instability example.

nodes.title: Independent finite-model numerical checks
nodes.statement: Round4 independent spinor/finite-difference checks and 512-to1024 momentum refinement support the recorded response implementation.
nodes.scope: Numerical evidence is not an implication proving M09; M09 has a separate analytic proof.
nodes.next_obligation: Keep failed coarse grids and test independent cutoff axes.

nodes.title: All-time response stability
nodes.statement: Determine whether a declared physical perturbation norm remains uniformly controlled for admissible states.
nodes.scope: Signed deltaW and ratios through field zeros cannot decide this.
nodes.next_obligation: Prove a coercive estimate or produce a controlled counterexample.

nodes.title: Hadamard and local-covariance framework
nodes.statement: Local covariant renormalization organizes admissible states and finite current/stress ambiguities.
nodes.scope: Zahn v3 section4.2 restricts background gauge curvature in its stress argument; do not generalize it silently.
nodes.next_obligation: Supply the force Ward identity for the actual nonzero electromagnetic background.

nodes.title: Common quantum current and directional stress
nodes.statement: Derive J,rho,p_perp,p_parallel from one state and common renormalization prescription.
assumptions: Common charge and gravitational finite terms
nodes.scope: An energy-only flat closure is insufficient for Einstein evolution.
nodes.next_obligation: Compare two subtraction schemes and verify the electromagnetic force Ward identity.

nodes.title: Full causal current/stress response blocks
nodes.statement: Construct retarded JJ,JT,TJ,TT variations with all contact terms from a causal state prescription.
assumptions: Same state and counterterms as one-point observables
nodes.scope: M10 computes only a homogeneous fixed-metric projection of the JJ block.
nodes.next_obligation: Derive the missing metric and stress variations.

nodes.title: Physically smeared quantum noise
nodes.statement: Compute symmetrized connected current and stress fluctuations with physical smearing.
nodes.scope: A source-amplitude derivative is not the symmetrized noise; no automatic nonequilibrium fluctuation-dissipation substitution.
nodes.next_obligation: Evaluate a reduced-model noise observable and compare it with causal response.

nodes.title: Controlled continuum limit
nodes.statement: Prove regulator-uniform bounds and convergence to a defined renormalized continuum model.
nodes.scope: Finite-grid existence cannot imply finite continuum energy; the critic supplies a divergent-energy counterexample.
nodes.next_obligation: Find tightness, subtraction and state-tail conditions that survive the limit.

nodes.title: Semiclassical validity criterion
nodes.statement: Determine where mean-field evolution approximates the intended quantum observables.
nodes.scope: Criteria and reduced-dimensional comparisons are informative but do not certify this 3+1 target.
nodes.next_obligation: Compare a tractable fully quantum benchmark and specify a failure threshold.

nodes.title: Axisymmetric Bianchi-I reduction
nodes.statement: Use ds²=-dt²+a_perp²(dx²+dy²)+a_parallel²dz² with aligned fields and diagonal total stress.
assumptions: Total matter, electromagnetic and supporting stresses
nodes.scope: This is a possible next geometry; it has neither a charged black-hole inner horizon nor dipole spatial structure.
nodes.next_obligation: Prepare consistent Einstein initial data and all directional stresses.

nodes.title: Total Ward defect
nodes.statement: Q=rhodot+2H_perp(rho+p_perp)+H_parallel(rho+p_parallel) measures total energy-conservation failure.
assumptions: Total rho and both total pressures
nodes.scope: Matter alone exchanges EJ with the field; total Q=0 requires the external/support sector too.
nodes.next_obligation: Evaluate Q from independently computed source expressions.

nodes.title: Bianchi-I constraint propagation
nodes.statement: Spatial Einstein evolution gives Cdot=-theta C-kappa Q; thus Q=0 and C(0)=0 preserve C=0.
assumptions: Constant kappa and stated stress convention
Constant cosmological term absorbed into total rho,p or set to zero
nodes.scope: This conditional geometric lemma does not supply the quantum closure or make Q vanish.
nodes.next_obligation: Prove Q=0 for the proposed quantum/support sources before Einstein integration.

nodes.title: Self-consistent quantum Bianchi-I evolution
nodes.statement: Solve the coupled geometry, fields and quantum state with constraint propagation and controlled validity.
nodes.scope: Field strengths near electron QED scales do not alone supply curvature of order m_e².
nodes.next_obligation: Close the directional stresses and verify the physical curvature budget.

nodes.title: Electric Weak Gravity Conjecture
nodes.statement: Conjecture an appropriately superextremal charged state relative to the relevant gravitational extremality relation.
assumptions: Declared gauge normalization and Planck convention
nodes.scope: q/m>=1 is not a convention-independent equation and force/extremality variants must be distinguished.
nodes.next_obligation: Freeze normalization and derive the correct charged-scalar extremality comparison.

nodes.title: Magnetic Weak Gravity Conjecture
nodes.statement: A magnetic/UV-scale version constrains the gauge-theory cutoff relative to gravity.
assumptions: Specified magnetic charges and cutoff meaning
nodes.scope: This is not simply the electric particle charge-to-mass inequality with E replaced by B.
nodes.next_obligation: Specify which magnetic version and EFT breakdown scale is being tested.

nodes.title: Festina Lente criterion
nodes.statement: Quasi-de Sitter discharge arguments motivate a lower charged-mass bound of schematic form m⁴≳g²q²H²M_Pl².
nodes.scope: Coefficients and content depend on conventions and the derivation; it is not proved by M09.
nodes.next_obligation: Compare the bound with the same-vacuum extremality and nonequilibrium decay calculation.

nodes.title: Charged de-Sitter decay compatibility
nodes.statement: Reconcile discharge, Hawking evaporation, extremality and possible WGC/FL constraints in one causal model.
nodes.scope: Phenomenological or conditional endpoint theorems are not a universal microscopic solution.
nodes.next_obligation: Reproduce a limiting decay model and replace one phenomenological rate with a controlled current.

nodes.title: Schwinger pair creation in prescribed fields
nodes.statement: Vacuum pair production is nonperturbative in an electric field; magnetic fields alter the charged spectrum.
nodes.scope: A prescribed-field production rate is not self-consistent current/stress backreaction.
nodes.next_obligation: Match a known exact limiting rate and distinguish real current from an imaginary effective action.

nodes.title: Euler–Heisenberg and curvature expansion
nodes.statement: One-loop local effective actions encode vacuum polarization only within their field, derivative and curvature assumptions.
assumptions: Avoid double counting dynamical fermion loops
nodes.scope: Fucci2009 treats constant magnetic fields, zero electric field and linear curvature; it is not an arbitrary R~m_e² closure.
nodes.next_obligation: Establish approximation control before applying it to strong curved electric fields.

nodes.title: Magnetized curved Schwinger backreaction
nodes.statement: Compute causal pair current and stress in a chosen strongly magnetized curved geometry, then evolve backreaction.
assumptions: Geometry, state and source supports fixed
Validity of field and curvature expansions
nodes.scope: The flat homogeneous finite theorem is a restricted analogue, not a solution of this curved problem.
nodes.next_obligation: Select one symmetry and test a controlled weak-curvature bridge first.

nodes.title: Classical mass inflation
nodes.statement: Coupled fluxes can destabilize charged inner horizons and produce mass inflation under specified data and decay assumptions.
nodes.scope: A theorem for a particular data class is not a universal statement about every horizon or quantum state.
nodes.next_obligation: Write the exact characteristic problem and match the hypotheses of the chosen theorem.

nodes.title: Quantum Cauchy-horizon endpoint
nodes.statement: Determine the backreacted endpoint when quantum stress, evaporation and inner-horizon dynamics interact.
nodes.scope: Fixed-background stress divergence and compact-region regularity arguments do not solve the nonlinear endpoint.
nodes.next_obligation: Compute a geometry-matched causal stress and evolve a constrained reduced system.

nodes.title: Perturbative photon–graviton conversion
nodes.statement: An external magnetic field couples photon and graviton perturbations; conversion depends on phase matching and polarization.
nodes.scope: This transverse wave sector differs from the homogeneous longitudinal Schwinger calculation.
nodes.next_obligation: Recover the known weak-field conversion matrix and Ward identities.

nodes.title: Quantum-dispersive conversion in strong fields
nodes.statement: Determine when QED birefringence, plasma and geometry suppress or permit coherent conversion.
nodes.scope: A constant lossless two-mode calculator is a benchmark, not a magnetar prediction.
nodes.next_obligation: Compute matched diagonal/off-diagonal wave operators and test limiting phase mismatch.
